description: The line plot illustrates the impact of the hyperparameter $N$ on the Area Under the Curve (AUC) metric, as part of the evaluation for the MADLLM method. The x-axis represents the value of $N$, ranging from 0 to 20, with labeled ticks at intervals of 5. The y-axis represents the AUC percentage, scaled from 75% to 100%, with major gridlines at 75%, 85%, 95%, and 100%. Six distinct lines, each with a unique color and marker style, depict the performance of different models or configurations. The blue line (circle markers) starts at approximately 94% AUC, rises to a peak of 98% at $N=10$, and then gradually declines to about 94% at $N=20$. The orange line (diamond markers) begins at 84%, increases to a peak of 95% at $N=15$, and then slightly decreases to 94% at $N=20$. The green line (star markers) starts at 86%, steadily increases to a peak of 94% at $N=15$, and then slightly decreases to 92% at $N=20$. The red line (square markers) starts at 87%, rises to a peak of 98% at $N=10$, and then declines to 91% at $N=20$. The magenta line (triangle markers) starts at 79%, dips slightly to 79% at $N=5$, peaks sharply at 96% at $N=10$, and then declines to 82% at $N=20$. The light blue line (inverted triangle markers) starts at 94%, rises to a peak of 98% at $N=10$, and then gradually declines to 94% at $N=20$.
